list._comment: WaitingScreen's contact list. No more centerOffsetY/maxHeight here (removed) — the list now fills the entire screen behind the settings icon/status strip (see #screenWaiting's own doc, styles.css, and WaitingScreen's Box, HomeScreens.kt). fadeHeightTop/fadeHeightBottom are each split in half by the mask itself (see .contact-list's own doc, styles.css): the outer half is a flat, already-fully-transparent zone sized to clear the icon/checklist's own real footprint, the inner half is where the actual visible fade transition happens. Confirmed live against each overlay's real rendered bounds, not guessed — see the same doc for the numbers.
